title: Budget and Revenue
text:
This page examines the relationship between film production budgets and worldwide revenues. Figure 1 plots each film’s budget against its worldwide revenue.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production Budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film budgets and worldwide revenues

title: Box Office Numbers
text: This website explores a dataset of 104 well-known films released between 1980 and 2025. The dataset includes information about each film’s franchise, production budget, worldwide revenue, runtime, and IMDb rating. The following pages explore several relationships and patterns in the data.

title: Runtime and Rating
text:
This page examines the relationship between film runtime and IMDb ratings. Figure 1 shows the rumtime and ratings for each film in the dataset.
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Ratings (0 to 10)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film runtime and their IMDb ratings
